item.title: US-Israeli attack on Iran personally impacts Raleigh residents
item.description: Families in central North Carolina are watching the Middle East conflict unfold not just on TV screens, but through phone calls, text messages, and video chats with loved ones in the region.

item.title: Crews demolishing vacant Wilson Mall, with future development planned
item.description: More than a decade after closing its doors, work continues to demolish the vacant Wilson Mall as the city looks to build a park and open up future private development at the site.

item.title: 19-year-old shot and killed in driveway in broad daylight, Sanford police seeking info
item.description: The Sanford Police Department has opened a murder investigation after a 19-year-old was shot and killed in broad daylight last week.

item.title: Duke claims outright ACC title with dominant performance at NC State
item.description: Cameron Boozer scored 26 points and added nine rebounds as the Blue Devils dominated NC State at Lenovo Center Monday night. The win clinches the outright ACC regular season title for Duke.

item.title: Fort Bragg, other military installations on high alert after attack on Iran
item.description: Military installations across North Carolina are on heightened alert as tensions arise overseas following the attack on Iran.
